about: Each refusal of `refine svd` the toy device can be brought to, run offline through the executable by devices/test.py's ToyGoldens: the edits made to toy.svd, the edits whose SVD the policy's svd_sha256 names (the SVD's own edits when absent), edits to the policy text, or a policy text of its own; the status refine exits with; and its report, faults/NAME.report.
